- Mon Mar 27, 11:00–11:20 PDT (Tue 00:00–00:20 SGT) — late on your side but doable if preferred

If none of those work, tell me a couple windows in your local time and I will match. I can send a calendar invite (with a short prep doc) once we lock something.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
